initialization: Existing 10-shot alignment checkpoint for the corresponding seed; new attention fusion initialized identically for matched/permuted/zero.
text_control: Same attention architecture. Select top-4 attributes using unchanged retrieval keys; matched values, fixed random derangement of values per seed, or zero values. No auxiliary attribute loss in this controlled comparison.
tail_definition: EfficientNet final MBConv stage plus final convolution; CLIP final transformer block plus ln_post and visual projection. Earlier layers frozen. BatchNorm running statistics and stochastic depth stay in eval mode in both regimes.
selection: Choose one head learning rate per backbone/regime/mode by mean validation macro-F1 over three seeds; ties by validation loss. Same two-candidate budget everywhere.
scope: Exploratory diagnostics on existing training and validation splits only. No new test evaluation and no confirmatory significance claims. Validation has been reused for development.
visual_audit: One validation image per species chosen by fixed seed, center crop, existing ag_attention checkpoint seed42. Assistant assessment of visible prompt support, not expert attribute annotation.
cache: Float32 activations immediately before trainable tail, train/validation only. Reconstructed features checked against full encoder. No random image augmentation, consistent with previous experiment.
